provenance.method: Each own native right pose independently partitioned; built-in image_gen supplies concealed garment material, cap-under hair and socked underclothes. No reflection, reused other-pose mask, skeletal replacement or whole-person deformation.

provenance.artAcceptance: Separate actual visual, pixel, real-game UI and delivery reports are required; collecting sources alone does not pass them.

independentIdentityLandmarks.scope: 80 independently observed native feature points; whole fixed-layer preservation is verified separately.

provenance.normalIdentity: Visible own-native hair, neck, ears, face and hands retain their RGBA; truly hidden side-view regions are recorded as occluded, not fabricated.
provenance.clothAlphaCleanup: Original near-opaque cloth alpha may be promoted from >=240 to255; original visible RGB and native source atlases are retained.
provenance.compact: Same-source LANCZOS 0.375 resize with body-front alpha>=248 core protection. Then clear exactly30 declared non-body outer samples at alpha1-4 to retain one transparent export pixel; includes23 generated-base and7 native-shoe antialias samples. All normal pixels and all body-front pixels are unchanged by this export policy. Other antialias edges may blend naturally.
provenance.frontItemsOnSideView: The native book remains held against the front torso under its own native hands. The separately approved small pineapple chest pin has an independent pass and source record; native gold cape fasteners remain cape details. The right badge pass is at z55 below cape60 and book70, with own-native identity at90; its chest location is preserved even when fully hidden. Occlusion follows each right pose.
provenance.fallback: Exact actual-loadout fallback for foreign items and failed current cells. Sealed down/up/fixed-left assets and load race/fallback code are unchanged.
